assumptions: Agent-oriented docs from docs/ai are available as canonical context.
Agent instruction packs and repo rules are present for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.
llms.txt and llms-full.txt expose the same persistence guidance in compact form.
The benchmark user asks for visible product behavior, not storage mechanics.

scenarios.title: Persisted theme preference
scenarios.prompt: Build a settings panel with a light/dark theme toggle that survives reloads and stays in sync across multiple tabs.

scenarios.title: Saved filters with ephemeral search draft
scenarios.prompt: Build a product search page with saved category filters that survive reloads, but keep the in-progress text search draft temporary.

scenarios.title: Clearable nullable field
scenarios.prompt: Build a profile nickname editor where the user can intentionally clear the nickname and keep it empty across reloads.

scenarios.title: Wizard draft with schema evolution
scenarios.prompt: Build an onboarding wizard draft that survives reloads and can upgrade old saved drafts when the step model changes.

scenarios.title: SSR theme badge
scenarios.focus: stable server output plus client hydration
scenarios.prompt: Build a server-rendered header badge that shows a stable theme placeholder on the server and then hydrates to the saved client preference after mount.

scenarios.title: Dismissed banner
scenarios.focus: simple durable UI state without user micromanagement
scenarios.prompt: Build a dashboard announcement banner that stays dismissed after the user closes it, even after refresh.
